lyrics-eng.text:
[Chorus]
Strictly business. Count it twice.
Fuel ain’t free, and neither am I.
Pay me up front. You’re buying a ride.
Saving the galaxy costs extra. Nice try.
[Verse]
Listen - My Bitch got money to spare. -She felling me
..but you got ta pay me to care, baby…pay me baby,
Baby, I Owe big Nigg Gah’s money honey, part of the smuggle game - naga hunting, ducking - ducking, bounty hunt-ahhhs, Jabbah funding,
If it’s all the same - then Trust - trust, not safe ta play with my name, my name
Scruffy? - scruffy! that was a low blow  - If I’m being formal - it’s el capatain Solo - Solo …Han to the Dolo.. Dolo….
And one thing i know though - the empire’s imperial GO GOs can suck a fat - oh no…
Oh no hoe, …..This junky ship - fastest in the galaxy!
This junky ship? Dustin Fleets, they can’t catch me! My Junky ship, Made Kessel - that set me free!
Beat the Maw,  less than twelve-par! Twelve-Par!
[Chorus]
Strictly business. Count it twice.
Fuel ain’t free, and neither am I.
Got my money. Had my out.
So why’d I turn this ship around?
[Verse 2]
Lay Ah, Lay ah, ! it is my junky home, my home, this my everything! I won’t tell  you a gain!, respect! Respect, put some on my name, on my name - So CHECK IT!
Captain Falcon - proud Scoundrel - light skipping, stop trippin - feel that speed, that speed!
You Got my cut? This ain’t fucking charity!
I do this for money, and maybe some depravity,
Chewbacka, status report - on the Gravity, gravity.
Start flipping switches, this bitch, got me twisted, I’m itching, I’ll show her what’s missing - our mission’s not slipping, her mission’s our mission! I’m hitting ignition
I will protect you princess…
Just Dont forget my fee -and Chewy, Chewy -
drop that beat..that beat
[Bridge]
Strap in fucka,  Line us up, coordinates locked - hang on to your butt. hang on to your butt
Finna crack 88 - light speed, thrusters hot.  Hot!
[Chorus]
Strictly business. Count it twice.
Fuel ain’t free, and neither am I.
Got my money. Had my out.
So why’d I turn this ship around?
[Verse 2]
Got my cut.
Crates in the back.
Told the kid, “Good luck.”
I ain’t comin’ back.
Chewie givin’ me that look.
Man, don’t start.
We ain’t gettin’ paid
To grow a fuckin’ heart.
Kid out there.
Whole fleet on his ass.
I got a clean way out.
Still ain’t hit the gas.
Fuck it.
Chewie, swing her back.
No - extra - charge.
Don’t get used to that. Use to that
[Bridge]
Strap in mother fucka,  Line us up, coordinates locked, peddle to the mettle, thrusters hot, hot… hot…hot…hang on to your butt.
[Chorus]
Strictly business. Count it twice.
Fuel ain’t free, and neither am I.
Got my money. Had my out.
So why’d I turn this ship around?
[Verse 3]
Playing the Hero? Playing the Hero?
Shoulda red the fine print.
Dinner date with Darth Vader? —
I ain’t order this shit.
I Tried to be her knight In that shinin’ armor.
So Vader put me on ice,
Now I’m her Carbon Knight.
I guess I got the title right …. got the title right.. night night…
Chewie, keep her safe,
don’t leave her alone
She can talk all that shit.
Just make sure she gets home.
She ain’t ask what I’m worth.
She ain’t ask what I owe.
She said, “I love you.”
I know…. I know.
[Final Chorus]
Strictly business. Count it twice.
Fuel ain’t free. Still paid that price.
Got my money. Had my out.
Still turned this motherfucker around.
[Outro]
I know.
I know
….
LISAN AL Gaib on the mic
…..
I know
…..
Voice from the outer world ,…
…
I know…
…
Shout out to Panhandlers!
…
I know….
I know…

waveform_comparison_method: Full audio decode to native-rate interleaved f32le for sample counts and hashes; independent mono8000Hz f32le decode for mean-centered normalized correlation,5s windows,+/-100ms lag. Sampled correlations do not establish whole-file identity or lyric alignment.

tools.python: Existing Python with NumPy; no package installation

path_base: All recorded relative paths are relative to repository root D:/Documents/CFA.

findings.audio_sample_timebase: All four decoded streams are 48000Hz stereo; each decoded audio sample frame is1/48000s. Container start offsets are separately recorded, not assumed to equal decoded sample origin.
findings.new_pair_sampled_audio_correspondence: Strong normalized waveform correspondence at15,110,220 seconds withzero sampled lag; different codecs and0.144s duration difference mean not an exact audio copy.
findings.old_vs_new_sampled_correspondence: Low normalized waveform correspondence at all three matched-time windows within+/-100ms. This rejects treating the new MP3 as a byte-identical or merely renamed baseline; it does not identify musical edits, quantify global alignment, or prove different lyrics.
findings.embedded_lyric_interpretation: New MP3 has the exact same embedded lyric text as old MP3 metadata. Tags can be stale or differ from sung words; audible lyric revisions remain unknown.
findings.new_mp4_visual_lyrics_review: No subtitle stream found. Any text burned into video pixels has not been transcribed or aligned in this audit.
findings.shot_timing_decision: Do not carry old subtitle timecodes forward automatically, apply a constant1.48s shift, or retime the shot plan from filenames/duration alone. Await listening/alignment against the newly selected master.
